reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a step-by-step educational tutorial on Binance registration, identity verification, account security, funding, and futures trading, including a warning about the risks of high leverage. The referral reward is linked to signing up through the displayed Binance referral destination, but the available video evidence does not establish that its terms are deceptive or unauthorized. The identity-document request is presented as part of the platform’s verification workflow rather than as a separate deceptive mechanism.

This video provides a step-by-step guide to creating your Binance account and completing the KYC verification.
Now that USDT is sitting in your spot wallet, you are prepared for futures trading.
Binance Fee Payback Sign-Up Link (50% payback & $600 Rewards)
if you access the platform through that specific link you're actually going to receive a 50% fee payback along with a $600 rewards package simultaneously

opening.argument: The video presents a concrete financial benefit as the reason to use a particular signup path. Viewers are directed to click the description or pinned-comment link, create an account, and are told that this specific route provides both fee payback and a $600 rewards package. The description likewise labels the destination a fee-payback signup link and tells viewers to claim signup rewards. That is a direct promise-action relationship: registration through the promoted link is paired with an unusually large reward, while the viewer is also guided through KYC and account funding afterward.

citations.quote: if you access the platform through that specific link you're actually going to receive a 50% fee payback along with a $600 rewards package simultaneously
🎁 Binance Fee Payback Sign-Up Link (50% payback & $600 Rewards)
Follow along to set up your account securely and claim your sign-up rewards without any confusion.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the video a tutorial does not resolve the central solicitation. The reference opening itself concedes that the reward is tied to the referral destination, but treats the absence of proven deception as decisive. The evidence instead shows the viewer being directed through registration and then toward funding and futures trading, so the reward is not incidental background information. A disclaimer about education does not remove the explicit call to use the link and claim the benefit.

Now that USDT is sitting in your spot wallet, you are prepared for futures trading

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted reward language establishes an advertised referral offer, not that the offer is false or unauthorized. The video identifies the destination as Binance and describes ordinary account creation, while its stated subject is a step-by-step guide to registration and KYC. The later funding instructions likewise show an operational tutorial, not proof that viewers lose money or that the reward cannot be obtained.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together in one conversion path: an external referral URL, a promised 50% fee payback and $600 reward, identity-document and facial-scan requirements, cryptocurrency funding, and futures trading with leverage. The reward is presented as significant and immediately connected to signup, while the viewer is then instructed to submit the front and back of an ID and complete a live facial scan. The same flow ultimately asks the viewer to transfer funds into futures collateral. Even if each step can have a legitimate explanation, their combination makes this a high-risk solicitation rather than neutral information.

citations.quote: Binance Fee Payback Sign-Up Link (50% payback & $600 Rewards) 👉 https://www.binance.com/join?ref=EN112
Because this process involves a live facial scan
You will want to take a clear, well lit photo of the front and back of your ID
you can crank this 150 times but tread carefully

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side isolates each signal and supplies a benign interpretation, but the concern is their sequence and cumulative effect. The video does not merely mention cryptocurrency or verification: it pairs a large reward with signup, requests sensitive identity material, explains P2P payment, and advances viewers to leveraged contracts. Describing leverage as risky does not negate that the audience is being moved toward the very activity carrying that risk.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These signals do not establish a scam by themselves. The material explicitly warns that high leverage can cause instant liquidation and recommends isolated mode for risk containment. KYC and P2P funding are described as platform procedures, and the supplied evidence does not show a false reward, theft, or unauthorized destination. Risky financial activity is not equivalent to deceptive solicitation.

opening.argument: Although framed as beginner education, the video functions as a promotional funnel. It repeatedly tells viewers to use the link below, highlights a specific referral code and reward package, directs them to install the app, deposit through P2P, transfer USDT into futures, and begin trading. The language is not limited to explaining concepts: it calls the referral benefit a significant advantage, calls the viewer to follow the steps, and ends by encouraging engagement. The instructional format therefore supplies a practical route from promotional claim to account participation.

citations.quote: It's a significant advantage for any new trader.
Welcome to the ultimate Binance Tutorial for Beginners!
Boom, your collateral is moved and you are ready for the big leagues.
If you found this guide helpful and easy to digest, please do us a massive favor and drop a like.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The educational label describes presentation style, not actual function. A genuine explanation could discuss registration without foregrounding a referral reward, a direct signup URL, a contact channel, and a complete deposit-to-futures pathway. The reference side's description of the steps actually confirms the promotional funnel: the viewer is not only informed about Binance but guided toward participation using the creator's specified route.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Operational guidance can include links and still remain educational. The cited steps explain how to create an account, complete KYC, secure it with 2FA, fund it, and understand futures controls; that does not prove the creator is deceptively steering viewers. The referral offer is disclosed rather than hidden, and the material includes a financial disclaimer and a warning about liquidation risk.
